overview_description.description:
Ada is a computer software company that features a chatbot-based platform that helps enterprise businesses to automate customer experience. Its platform operates through both web and mobile machine learning engine that reduces support volume and empowers customers to find answers on their own.

The company was founded in 2016 and headquartered in Toronto in Canada.

about_short_description.short_description: Ada is an automated customer experience company that provides chat bots used in customer support.

product.name: Ada AI Customer Service Platform
product.description: A cloud-based AI customer service platform that automates support interactions, resolves customer inquiries, and connects with business systems across channels and languages.

product.name: Ada Messaging
product.description: An AI-powered messaging product for automating customer support conversations across major messaging and social channels, with human handoff when required.

product.name: Ada Voice
product.description: An AI voice support product that automates phone conversations, handles customer inquiries, and enables escalation or callback scheduling with human agents.

product.name: Ada Email
product.description: An AI email support product that automates customer service responses, uses company knowledge and data, and escalates complex requests to human agents.

product.name: Ada AI Agent Management
product.description: A set of tools for measuring, testing, coaching, and improving AI customer service agent performance across automated conversations.

product.name: Ada Integrations and Developer Tools
product.description: APIs, SDKs, and prebuilt integrations that connect Ada with knowledge sources, CRMs, ticketing systems, data platforms, and communication tools.
